You can buy a near luxury car, brand new, for about $70k in cash.  You can get a much better deal if you buy used.  The opportunity cost of that $70k is around $4k a year, or a little over $300 a month.  I really don't understand people who saddle themselves with huge monthly payments.

"I don't have $70k in cash" you say?  How about $30k?  You can get a perfectly good used car for $30k.  You don't have $30k?  Do you have $5k?  Put $5k down on a $30k car and pay the difference between the monthly payments on that expensive car you wanted and the $30k car to yourself.  Eventually you will have that $30k.

If you are even $1 upside down, it's terrible.  It's stupid and it's terrible.  You are literally flushing money down the toilet.
